mechanisms.note: BIOSENSOR_SCOPE: Most aptamer literature is detection/biosensor-only. Only Bilibana2022 RNA-GO and CN121588773A DNA-GC have adsorption evidence.

boundary_rules.rule: Biosensor LOD/Kd values from detection papers must not be used as adsorption capacity evidence.
RNA-GO MC-LR is review-sourced and RNA-based, not independently replicated DNA aptamer adsorption.
CN121588773A DNA-GC is AFB1-specific, in vivo/biomedical, patent-backed. Figure-derived qmax needs human approval.
